data: Apple's total net sales were $383.3 billion in fiscal 2023, which ended September 30, 2023, and $416.2 billion in fiscal 2025, which ended September 27, 2025. That is an increase of about $32.9 billion, or roughly 8.6%, over the two years. Most of the growth came in fiscal 2025: revenue rose only about 2% to $391.0 billion in fiscal 2024, then grew about 6.4% the following year. These figures come from my training knowledge of Apple's 10-K filings and were not retrieved live, so check them against the filings for exact precision.
